title: Assa Abloy Australia Pacific Pty Ltd acquisitions of the Seal Doors Group and E Plus Building Products Pty Ltd
acquirers: Assa Abloy Australia Pacific Pty Ltd
targets: Seal Doors Group, and E Plus Building Products Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Informal Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC requested further information from Assa Abloy.
ACCC received further information from Assa Abloy
ACCC requested further information from Assa Abloy.
ACCC received further information from Assa Abloy.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
ACCC discontinued its public review after Assa Abloy informed of its intention to withdraw its proposed acquisition of E Plus.

body_sections.Summary: On 29 March 2019, Assa Abloy acquired the Seal Doors Group, including seven of its subsidiaries (but not E Plus). Assa Abloy also proposed to acquire E Plus.
